property_summary: After proper initialization (MinSum set, a functioning log file registered), any depositor can deposit and later withdraw their funds without reverting; in the mutant, Log is set to address(this), so Put's AddMessage call re-enters C's locked fallback and the deposit (and hence the full deposit-withdraw cycle) reverts.
change_summary: Replace the assignment with `Log = LogFile(address(this));` so Log is set to the contract's own address instead of _log.
